criteria.rank: detector-consensus count, then |z| within a tier

selection.rule: per-metric floor, then highest averages on eligible counts; within a metric, global rank order

freeze_day_review.decision_rationale: Dry run showed the global rank cut giving ozone 3 of 50 slots off the second-largest eligible pool (568 events) while sulfur dioxide took 18 off 201. The |z| tiebreak compares a within-metric quantity across metrics, so it ranks by how spiky a pollutant is rather than how anomalous an event is, and it starves the secondary-formation and photochemistry claim types. Stratified by pollutant: floor of 5, then highest averages on eligible counts. Every floor is fillable from three-detector events, so no metric reaches into weakly evidenced ones, and the allocation is insensitive to the proportional denominator (all events, 2+ detector, or 3-detector give ozone 11/10/11).

baseline_locality.anchor_semantics: B2/B8 UTC-hour centers; centered endpoint-inclusive 72-hour window; baseline through anchor-3 hours

censoring.anchor_semantics: B2/B8 UTC-hour centers; baseline endpoint-inclusive from anchor-36 h through anchor-3 h

channel_coverage_screen.rule: representative eligible iff >= min_fresh_channels distinct channels have a B8-fresh event-time observation; missing enrichment is unscreened and blocks freeze-day acceptance instead

nomination_eligibility.trigger_channel_consequence: ground_insitu trigger support is demoted for type-1 claims; positive non-circular evidence must come from another channel

observation_age_gates.anchor_semantics: B2/P0b UTC-hour centers with endpoint-inclusive +/-36 h contexts wholly inside the study interval

purpleair_time_aware_qc.stored_field: raw ATM; no Barkjohn correction in this evaluation
purpleair_time_aware_qc.window_semantics: UTC-hour centers; [center-12h, center+12h), clamped at study edges

construction.deseasonalization: subtract each series' window-wide UTC-hour-of-day mean
construction.lag_orientation: candidate x(t-L) paired with pollutant y(t)

screen.expected_outcome_declared_before_run: zero drops likely; gh_500 has a synoptic ridging/subsidence to stagnation mechanism and precipitable_water has a moisture/washout mechanism; parameters must not be weakened to manufacture pruning

method.rng: numpy SeedSequence.spawn in sorted cell order

statistical_caveats: uncorrected multiplicity is keep-biased under the all-cells rule
autocorrelation can inflate significance and is keep-biased here
iid-bootstrap confidence intervals may be too narrow and are keep-biased here
